title: Game jams
role: Level design, world building and 3D art
owned: Three jam games made with friends: The Great Esc (Unreal Game Jam 2024, 2nd place, Unreal Engine 4), Duality / It's Just You (Global Game Jam 2022, Unreal Engine 5, where my part was world building, level design and 3D art) and Undeady Issues (Global Game Jam 2019, Unreal Engine 4).
brief: Make complete games with friends in constrained jam time, testing design ideas outside the studio pipeline.
problem: Time, people and tools are limited, so every decision is a design decision.
approach: Three jam games made with friends.
result: 2nd place at Unreal Game Jam 2024 with The Great Esc.
reflection: Jams force the full design loop into a small scope, so you learn what is essential fast.
summary: Three jam games made with friends, including The Great Esc, 2nd place at Unreal Game Jam 2024.
